name: JARVIS Idea v1 (check my product idea)

parameters.content:
## JARVIS Idea v1 - check the owner's own product idea, then list it on Shopify after approval
Called by **JARVIS Brain** (a photo, link or "check <product>" on Telegram, or the agent's check_product_idea tool) at `/webhook/jarvis-idea`.
Steps: what is it (free AI, sees photos) → your rules (no batteries/chargers, no beauty, kids, food, medical; certification flags) → best 3 CJ suppliers (Canada/US warehouses first) with shipping to Canada → market: Google Shopping Canada (incl. Amazon.ca prices when listed) and Google Trends Canada (2 SerpApi searches, cached 10 days) → verdict, price, fees, profit, marketing and Amazon FBA estimates, risks → report on Telegram with **Approve / Decline** (72 h).
**On Approve:** product created on Shopify (title FR, description FR+EN, CJ photos, price, matching collection, CJ SKU), published to the Online Store, live link sent; then the video team renders 3 short videos (server voice service) and sends them with captions and hashtags. You connect the product in the CJ app (1 min). Amazon: prepared only once your seller account + SP-API are connected, with a separate approval before buying stock. TikTok Shop has no official data: not checked.
**Credentials:** *Webhook*: **JARVIS screen key**; *CJ get token*: **CJ API key**; SerpApi nodes: **SerpApi**; OmniRoute nodes: **OmniRoute**; *Shopify token*: Custom Auth **Rangéo Shopify app** (Dev Dashboard app: client ID + secret, scopes read_orders, read_products, write_products, read_publications, write_publications); Telegram nodes: **JARVIS Telegram**.
